TEAR-ROD.description: Gain 5 [gold]Over Limit[/gold] at the start of your turn.
TEAR-ROD.flavor: A plain cane, until Tear starts swinging it around.
TEAR-ROD.title: Cane
TEAR-BLUE_CRYSTAL_ROD.description: Gain 2 additional [gold]Over Limit[/gold] from cards and at the start of your turn.
TEAR-BLUE_CRYSTAL_ROD.flavor: A fonic rod crowned with a brilliant blue crystal. Subtlety was never the point.
TEAR-BLUE_CRYSTAL_ROD.title: Blue Crystal Rod
TEAR-FONSTONE_FRAGMENT.description: At the start of combat, gain a random elemental [gold]Fonon[/gold].
TEAR-FONSTONE_FRAGMENT.flavor: A tiny shard of fonstone, still humming with whatever element got stuck inside.
TEAR-FONSTONE_FRAGMENT.title: Fonstone Fragment
TEAR-SPIRIT_BANGLE.flavor: A simple bangle that keeps the wearer's fonic energy ready to boil over.
TEAR-SPIRIT_BANGLE.title: Spirit Bangle
TEAR-THROWING_KNIFE.description: The first [gold]Arte[/gold] you play each combat is free to play.
TEAR-THROWING_KNIFE.flavor: Technically a weapon. Mostly a very sharp way to get things started.
TEAR-THROWING_KNIFE.title: Throwing Knife
TEAR-HOLY_CROSS.description: At the end of combat, [gold]Heal[/gold] 5 HP.
TEAR-HOLY_CROSS.flavor: A small cross said to soothe wounds. Five HP at a time, apparently.
TEAR-HOLY_CROSS.title: Holy Cross
TEAR-UNICORN_HORN.description: At the start of combat, add a random [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] to your hand.
TEAR-UNICORN_HORN.flavor: It doesn't belong to an actual unicorn. Probably.
TEAR-UNICORN_HORN.title: Unicorn Horn
TEAR-FONIC_ROD.description: Whenever you gain an elemental [gold]Fonon[/gold], deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
TEAR-FONIC_ROD.flavor: Turns ambient fonic energy into something considerably less ambient.
TEAR-FONIC_ROD.title: Fonic Rod
TEAR-FONIC_CREST.flavor: A crest resonating with concentrated fonic power. Apparently Over Limit needed an encore.
TEAR-FONIC_CREST.title: Fonic Crest
TEAR-TEARS_PENDANT.flavor: A familiar pendant kept close to the heart. It makes every [gold]Arte[/gold] hit a little closer to someone else's.
TEAR-TEARS_PENDANT.title: Tear's Pendant
